problems.quote: A majority of the votes was invalid (singular verb with majority as collective unit)
problems.problem: The verb should agree with the plural noun 'votes' following 'of', so it must be plural 'were', not singular 'was'. The explanation incorrectly treats 'majority' as a collective unit overriding the of-noun rule.
problems.correction: A majority of the votes were invalid (plural verb agreeing with plural 'votes')
problems.verifierReason: Original uses singular verb with plural 'votes'; correct form is plural 'were'. Proposed correction is accurate.

problems.quote: any deviation — such as omitting the statutory limitation period — renders the notice procedurally defective
problems.problem: A legal notice does not require inclusion of a statutory limitation period; omitting it does not make the notice procedurally defective. Also, drafting on plain paper and sending by registered post are not universal legal requirements.
problems.correction: omitting the limitation period does not automatically invalidate a legal notice
problems.verifierReason: Legal notice need not mention limitation period; omission not procedurally defective.
